supersedes: implicit ad-hoc PID usage in supervised_ue_run.py / lease_store
principle: Every process identity that carries authority MUST be persisted as the triple (role, pid, creation_time). A naked PID is never authoritative. Windows recycles PIDs, so PID-only identity cannot be validated after the fact and is the direct cause of the historical receipt defect.

controller.definition: the process that decides to mutate and holds the decision context

supervisor.definition: the governed harness process that acquires the lease, spawns, supervises and emits the receipt

launcher.definition: the direct child created by Popen; may be a wrapper stub (on Windows a venv python.exe respawns the base interpreter)

logical_owner.definition: the process that logically owns the mutation, after wrapper resolution
logical_owner.note: on Windows the launcher PID and the logical owner PID can differ; identity authority must come from the resolved owner, never from the launcher PID alone

mutation_root.definition: the outermost governed process that performs the mutation and is assigned to the Job Object

executor.definition: a transient resolved member of the Job tree
executor.creation_time: required IF the pid is persisted
executor.rule: either persist pid + creation_time + explicit role, or omit the field entirely. A naked executor PID is forbidden. Because the executor may exit before the receipt is written, it must never be load-bearing for authority.

owns_lease.rationale: the lease must identify the process that actually mutates, not the harness that supervises it. A supervisor-owned lease cannot prove the mutation root was governed.
owns_lease.two_stage_rationale: the mutation root does not exist until after Popen returns. Stage 1 acquires an admission lease bound to the supervisor so concurrent mutation is denied from the outset; Stage 2 rebinds root_pid and root_creation_time to the real mutation root immediately after Job assignment and before the run is treated as RUNNING.

heartbeat_validates.on_failure: must NOT refresh RUNNING. Transition to STALE (or terminal) and stop representing the lease as valid coverage.

terminal_transition.requirement: every terminal path must move the lease out of RUNNING and persist end_utc plus terminal_state. The existing release(lease, terminal_state) already does this; the harness simply never called it.

forbidden: persisting an authoritative PID without its creation_time
continuing to heartbeat a lease whose owner is dead or PID-reused
adopting an unrelated pre-existing lease as authority for a new run
leaving a lease in RUNNING after the supervised operation terminates
treating codepath evidence of Job assignment as runtime membership proof
presenting a post-hoc reconciliation receipt as producer-emitted
identity_verification_helper: lease_store.owner_alive(root_pid, root_creation_time) already exists and correctly compares a live process creation time against the recorded one. It was defined but never consulted by heartbeat().
